page.running_head: De R. Eccl. idololatria lib.1. cap.IX

main_text.p: minor sum omnibus beneficiis & miserationibus tuis,ô Iehova. Veruntamen pulvis & cinis supplicare tibi non desistam, ut instituas opus manuum mearum,coeptumque tua gratia prosequi digneris; Ezek.8.3.& sequentibus.& sicut {*}Iudaeorum abominationes in idolo zelotypiae,simulacris omnigenis,Tammuzo,& Sole venerando, per Ezekielem ipsis ostendisti; ita Pontificiis impietatem suam in cultu Sanctorum, reliquiarum,imaginum, rerum consecratarum,& sacramenti Eucharistiae, per servum tuum patefacias.

page.notes: The reference mark after "sicut" is a small asterisk-like sign in the text; the marginal note "Ezek.8.3.& sequentibus." beside that line carries it. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The ornament below the text is a woodcut, not transcribed. The word "fervum" in the printed line is set with a long s and is transcribed as "servum"; the printed line "per fervum tuum" is shown with its catchword-adjacent layout and reads "per servum tuum". The lines "per servum tuum / patefacias." are centred and set apart, but form the end of the same paragraph.
